proposed_macOS_first_user_GUI_flow.proposed_behavior: One graphical controller shows requested channel/version and detected runtime/bundle versions; no Terminal bootstrap. Cancel before mutation leaves existing app usable.
Show verified owned app locations/target. Retain newer runtime under N627, explicitly offer same-version repair and stage old-to-new. Ambiguous/unowned launch targets block unsafe replacement.

All first-user choices default off here; upgrades retain existing choices. Pass explicit collected values to helper with no TTY questions. N700 supplies final cloud/public consent wording; do not blindly reuse manual-Send-only text.

Show required space and target; preserve caches/models/data/preferences by default. Separate default-off cleanup lists exact eligible paths/contents/counts/sizes. Do not offer arbitrary custom runtime root before launcher can resolve and verify it.

Download/authenticate and stage dependencies while old working app remains intact. Progress, retry/cancel and details remain here. OS-owned administrator authorization uses native dialog; app never captures passwords.

Verify requested/effective version, distribution/facade/get_version/module/interpreter/prefix using intended desktop import rules. Frozen payload also requires signing/architecture/inventory. Wrong identity is failure, not success display metadata.

Cooperative close consent, owned lock and bound transaction precede activation. Retain previous recovery tree/journal until actual GUI confirms identity; retire only verified obsolete active app code/launchers. Rollback/recovery remains truthful.

Only actual GUI identity receipt permits complete success. Show effective version and optional installation details. Failure/retry remains in controller with usable-old or first-install-incomplete state; no questions remain in Terminal after window closes.
